name: Necrótico - [MMMM]
description:
If you want to see the most harmful effects of Necrótico Dano, look inward, not outward. Necrótico Dano erodes the soul. Necrótico Dano is misery, and misery loves
company. Treat what you can, but be aware your patient may need a Cleric more than hey need a surgeon.

results.description: Você testemunhou uma escuridão profunda e, mesmo agora, pode sentir seu toque persistente em sua alma. Seu alinhamento muda um passo em direção ao mal. Se você já é mau, trate este teste como um 15.
results.name: Alma Corrompida

results.description: You feel like you've seen the face of death and can recall its grim visage with ease. You require one less failed death saving throw before you die.
results.name: Tenuous Grip on Life

results.description:
Your wound festers with a dark energy. It resists both magical and natural healing. Your maximum hit points are reduced by the amount of Dano that caused the Lesão Persistente.

Tratamento - A DC 18 General Cirurgia check or the Greater Restoration spell.
results.name: Necrótico Ferida

results.description: You feel frail, drained, as if your life's very essence has been stolen away from you. You have disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and both Strength and Constitution saving throws for [[1d4]] days.
results.name: Withered Longe

results.description:
You are filled with a blind rage and an overwhelming violent compulsion. You immediately use your reaction to make a melee attack against the nearest creature (at random). You spend the next [[1d4]] turns pursuing and attacking whatever creature is closest to you, regardless of if they are friendly or not.

Tratamento - Any spell or effect that would end a Barbarian's rage also ends this effect.
results.name: Malicious Outburst

results.description: All positive emotion within you shatters like a mirror and you are left only with painful, distracting shards. If you have Inspiration, you lose it. You lose any nonmagical effect granting you a temporary bonus or advantage (such as Bardic Inspiration, Barbarian Rage, the Dodge action, or the Help action).
results.name: Sorrow

results.description:
You are plagued by the lingering stench of rotting flesh. It clings to you and is perceivable by anyone within 5 feet of you. For [[1d6]] days you have disadvantage on all Charisma based checks.

Tratamento - Scouring clean in a long, hot bath will reduce the duration of this effect by [[1d6]] days.
results.name: The Stench of Decay

results.description:
Você sente a energia negativa se agarrando a você, trabalhando ativamente contra você. Você é afligido como se fosse pelo feitiço Conceder Maldição, com a maldição específica escolhida aleatoriamente, ou pelo Mestre. Para fins de identificação de alvos, presume-se que a fonte do dano seja o conjurador da maldição. A maldição dura até o próximo nascer do sol.

Tratamento - Um feitiço Remover Maldição acabará com esse efeito, como de costume.
results.name: Amaldiçoado

results.description: Role na the @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. You are left with a curious scar that appears to be a shadow over the wounded area. No amount of light seems to be able to eliminate this shadow.
results.name: Sombra Cicatriz

results.description: Role no @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Você fica com uma escuridão persistente ao longo das veias nesta área do seu corpo.
results.name: Vasos Escuros

results.description: You cannot be magically healed for [[1d6]] turns. This includes spells which restore hit points, cure conditions, and raise the dead.
results.name: Mitotic Rejection

results.description:
You are struck by a short, traumatic vision of your own demise, and your heart is filled with dread at this portent. You have vulnerability to the next source of Dano that harms you, after which this effect ends.

Tratamento - The Remove Curse spell ends this effect.
results.name: Path to Your Grave

results.description:
Roll on the @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large Limb Table}. This limb is pale, bloodless, and dead. Yet somehow...you can still move it normally. The limb emits a faint aura of Necromancy. You can suppress this effect with an effort of concentration. This renders your physical limb inanimate and a ghostly, phantom limb appears from within it, staying attached to you. This incorporeal limb can pass through creatures and objects and interact with both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal Plane. If the Phantom Limb ever spends more than 6 seconds inside an object, it flickers from existence and you take [[/damage 1d6 force]].

Treatment - Any spell that returns the dead to life will return your limb to normal, provided you follow the spell's normal requirements.
results.name: Fantasma Membro

results.description: Slowly, you feel the building urge to destroy something beautiful. You have [[1d6]] days to commit an act of senseless destruction or violence (outside of what would be normal behavior for your character). If you do not do this within the time limit, the compulsion builds to distracting levels, and you have disadvantage to all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until you do.
results.name: Insidious Compulsion

results.description: Todas as células do seu corpo protestam quando são agredidas pelo próprio fluxo do tempo. Seu corpo envelhece [[1d10]] anos. Sua mente não é afetada.
results.name: Cronoscarred

results.description: A small mote of corrupt power has taken residence within you and you feel a tiny part of your soul become unhinged. You take a flaw that would be considered malevolent, violent, cruel, or volatile.
results.name: Felt the Escuros
